description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Machina Cognita Technologies is hiring a Software Engineer - Android to develop native Android applications and contribute across the software development life cycle. The role partners with product managers and engineers to build prototypes, translate client needs into solutions, and support product implementation and optimization.
Android application engineer building client prototypes, APIs, integrations, and pilot deployments

Responsibilities:
• Build proof-of-concept prototypes and client demonstrations to win contract bids and drive new business opportunities
• Design, develop, and maintain native Android applications
• Contribute to system architecture and technical design discussions
• Monitor system performance and identify and resolve issues to improve reliability
• Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and backend services
• Run pilot implementations, troubleshoot issues, and drive resolution
• Collaborate with product managers and engineers to translate client needs into innovative solutions
• Travel to client destinations to facilitate product delivery and provide ongoing support and optimization

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or related field
• 1-5 years of professional software development experience
• Proficient in Java and Kotlin
• Proficient in ObjectBox, SQLite, or another mobile database framework
• Proficient in version control systems
• Proficient in relational databases and distributed storage systems
• Proficient in containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes
• Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills
